about: Commonplace exam phrasing that G7 (scripts/clean/gates.py) does not count as copying. Our own list (2026-09-29 draft): stock rubric and set-up phrases used across all boards and textbooks. The user reviews and extends it; keep each entry generic (no scenario words). An 8-word run is exempt when at least 6 of its words are maths tokens or lie inside one of these phrases. Entries after 'the finite region r is bounded by' (added 2026-09-30) are generic phrases that describe a mathematical configuration; they are on the review list (checklist §28) for the user and the solicitor. Rubric phrases for answer forms and constants, and generic set-up phrases, added 2026-09-30 after the pilot (also on the review list).
